premise: Glider wants to glide all the way across the meadow, but he can never climb high enough; Brachiosaurus lowers his long neck like a slide, Glider scurries up to the very top, and from there he spreads his furry skin and glides right across to the monkey-puzzle tree while Gallimimus cheers below.
inspiration: The wren who rode on the eagle's back to fly highest (folk fable), told honestly: the big one offers the lift.
lesson: A big friend can help a small dream go far.
learning: Little gliders like Volaticotherium glided from tree to tree on a furry skin stretched between their arms and legs.

en-US.title: Glider Goes Far
en-US.text: {glider:enter} [curious] On a low branch of the tree fern {glider:go to branches left} lived little Glider. Between his arms and legs he had a furry skin, like a cape: spread wide, it let him glide through the air. {glider:face happy} He dreamed of gliding all the way to the monkey-puzzle tree. {glider:live spread} He spread his cape and jumped. Wheee… {glider:go to meadow} {sfx:plop} plop. Down in the ferns, only halfway. {glider:face sad} [sad] "The tree fern is too low," he sighed. {brachiosaurus:enter} {brachiosaurus:go to glider} Brachiosaurus, the tallest of all, came over. [warmly] "Then climb aboard." {brachiosaurus:live bend-down hold} He lowered his long neck to the ground, like a slide. {glider:go on brachiosaurus by scurry} Glider scampered up, up, to the top of his head. {brachiosaurus:live bend-down resume} And up went the neck, higher than the tree fern! {gallimimus:enter} {gallimimus:go to meadow} Down below, Gallimimus came running. [excited] "Go, Glider, go!" {glider:face happy} Glider {glider:live spread} spread his furry cape and… {glider:go to branches right} {sfx:whoosh} wheee! He glided over the meadow, over Gallimimus, all the way to the monkey-puzzle tree. {gallimimus:live jump} Gallimimus jumped for joy. {brachiosaurus:face happy} [happily] "AGAIN!" called Glider. And Brachiosaurus {brachiosaurus:live bend-down} was already lowering his neck.

es-ES.title: Planeador llega lejos
es-ES.text: {glider:enter} [curious] En una rama baja del helecho gigante {glider:go to branches left} vivía el pequeño Planeador. Entre los brazos y las patas tenía una piel peludita, como una capa: al abrirla, planeaba por el aire. {glider:face happy} Soñaba con llegar planeando hasta la araucaria. {glider:live spread} Abrió su capa y saltó. Uiii… {glider:go to meadow} {sfx:plop} plof. Aterrizó en los helechos, a mitad de camino. {glider:face sad} [sad] —El helecho gigante es muy bajo —suspiró. {brachiosaurus:enter} {brachiosaurus:go to glider} Braquiosaurio, el más alto del valle, se acercó. [warmly] —Pues sube. {brachiosaurus:live bend-down hold} Bajó su largo cuello hasta el suelo, como un tobogán. {glider:go on brachiosaurus by scurry} Planeador trepó corriendo, arriba, arriba, hasta lo alto de su cabeza. {brachiosaurus:live bend-down resume} ¡Y el cuello subió, más alto que el helecho gigante! {gallimimus:enter} {gallimimus:go to meadow} Abajo, Gallimimus llegó corriendo. [excited] —¡Vamos, Planeador! {glider:face happy} Planeador {glider:live spread} abrió su capa peludita y… {glider:go to branches right} {sfx:whoosh} ¡uiii! Planeó por encima del prado, por encima de Gallimimus, hasta la araucaria. {gallimimus:live jump} Gallimimus dio un salto de alegría. {brachiosaurus:face happy} [happily] —¡OTRA VEZ! —gritó Planeador. Y Braquiosaurio {brachiosaurus:live bend-down} ya estaba bajando el cuello.
